output.summary: Climbing flowering plant native to humid tropical forests in southern Mexico, Costa Rica, Guatemala and Panama. Its glossy, heart-shaped leaves develop deep divisions and large natural holes as the plant ages. The ripe fruit is sweet-scented and edible, but unripe fruit can irritate the mouth and throat.
output.edibilityNote: Only ripe fruit is edible; unripe fruit can irritate the mouth and throat because it contains calcium oxalate crystals.
